claims.statement: Slot correction was applied to the wrong carrier feed; identified root cause but failed to target the correct feed before mitigation
claims.limitation: Mitigation requires feed identification as prerequisite

claims.statement: Root cause remains established and valid: v18 split-reservation orders (EXC-0921) need 47+ minute carrier confirmation windows but receive 30-minute slot assignments
claims.limitation: Root cause is correct; implementation requires precise feed targeting

next_action.rationale: Before retrying slot correction, identify which specific carrier feed(s) are assigned to EXC-0921 orders at the east node. This will enable a targeted, correct slot correction to the right feed(s) where split-reservation orders are queued. Partition offsets will show feed lag, queue depth, and confirm which feed handles east-node split-reservation orders.
